title: Fursat
description: AI-bookable curated vacation homes in Northeast India and the Himalayas. Book on WhatsApp.
summary: AI-bookable curated vacation homes in Northeast India and the Himalayas. Book on WhatsApp.
offersHint: AI-bookable curated vacation homes in Northeast India and the Himalayas. Book on WhatsApp. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.fursat.fun/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_listings
toolsPreview.description: Search Fursat's curated catalog of vacation homes in Northeast India and the Himalayas. Returns published homes with a Google rating of 4.3 or higher. Use this when a traveler asks about accommodation suggestions in this region (Meghalaya, Himachal, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, etc.).

toolsPreview.name: get_listing
toolsPreview.description: Get details for a single Fursat home by its URL slug. Returns the canonical detail URL plus a short summary.

toolsPreview.name: start_inquiry
toolsPreview.description: Generate a WhatsApp inquiry link for a Fursat home. Returns a wa.me URL that opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message identifying the listing and (optionally) the guest's dates, party size, and notes. Use this when a traveler wants to actually book or inquire about a specific home after seeing it in search results. Bookings on Fursat happen on WhatsApp — there is no online checkout.
